dct_description_sm: Precipitation is a measure used to measure weather and climate . In the long term measured precipitation to allow for comparisons between annual, seasonal and monthly values. Precipitation can be used as an indicator for changes in the climate. measurement series must be long partly because you have to take into account natural variations and partly because change happens slowly. Precipitation is also used to calculate groundwater flows and flows in rivers. Precipitation in Abisko is low compared with many parts of Sweden. That's because the Abisko is located in the rain shadow of the Scandinavian Mountains in the West. Abisko is covered by snow most of the year, but snow depth is difficult to measure because the snow is unevenly distributed depending on whether it blows away or collected, depending on the topography and vegetation.
dct_title_s: The eye of Abisko (Abiskogat) - weather and precipitation data in the Abisko Area, Sweden
